# Dux

> Distributed DuckDB-native DataFrames for Elixir

Dux is an Elixir library that provides a dplyr-style verb API backed by DuckDB's analytical engine, with built-in distributed execution across the BEAM.

## Key facts

- Lazy by default: operations accumulate as an AST, compiled to SQL CTEs on materialization
- DuckDB is the only engine: no pluggable backends, full access to DuckDB's SQL functions and 50+ extensions
- The module IS the dataframe: `Dux.filter(df, ...)` not `Dux.DataFrame.filter(df, ...)`
- Distributed on the BEAM: `%Dux{}` is plain data — ship it to any BEAM node, compile to SQL there
- No Series API: all operations are dataframe-level

## Links

- Documentation: https://hexdocs.pm/dux
- Hex package: https://hex.pm/packages/dux
- Source code: https://github.com/elixir-dux/dux
- Getting started guide: https://hexdocs.pm/dux/getting-started.html
- Livebook integrations: https://github.com/elixir-dux/kino_dux

## Installation

```elixir
def deps do
  [{:dux, "~> 0.3.0"}]
end
```

## Core API (verbs)

- `Dux.from_parquet/2`, `Dux.from_csv/2`, `Dux.from_excel/2`, `Dux.from_ndjson/2` — read data
- `Dux.from_query/1` — raw SQL source
- `Dux.from_attached/3` — read from attached databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, etc.)
- `Dux.filter/2` — filter rows (WHERE)
- `Dux.mutate/2` — add or replace columns
- `Dux.select/2` — keep columns
- `Dux.discard/2` — drop columns
- `Dux.group_by/2` — group for aggregation
- `Dux.summarise/2` — aggregate (GROUP BY)
- `Dux.sort_by/2` — sort rows (ORDER BY)
- `Dux.join/3` — inner, left, right, cross, anti, semi joins
- `Dux.asof_join/3` — time-series nearest-match join
- `Dux.head/2` — first N rows (LIMIT)
- `Dux.distinct/1` — deduplicate
- `Dux.pivot_wider/4`, `Dux.pivot_longer/3` — reshape
- `Dux.window/3` — window functions
- `Dux.distribute/2` — mark for distributed execution
- `Dux.compute/1` — execute the pipeline
- `Dux.to_rows/1` — execute and return list of maps
- `Dux.to_parquet/3`, `Dux.to_csv/3`, `Dux.to_excel/2` — write data
- `Dux.insert_into/3` — write to database table
